symptom: Date.parse accepts 2026-10-14T24:00:00Z as the next day. The v70 offline candidate passed 21/23 clock regression assertions; explicit clock-range candidate passed 23/23, but is not committed or CI-verified.
lesson: Gregorian calendar validation alone does not establish RFC3339 time validity: JavaScript Date.parse can roll 24:00 to the following day.
guardrail: Validate hour 00..23, minute 00..59, second 00..59, and timezone offset bounds before Date.parse; retain explicit 24:00 negative fixtures, and require committed repository CI before merge.
